tpms.when: 2007–2013 when the light came on for low pressure and no wheels were moved
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
The low tire pressure light and the CHECK TIRE PRESSURE message clear once the pressures are corrected; there is no button to press.
Drive for a few minutes above about 25 mph so the sensors report the new pressures, then check the readings on the Driver Information Center.
If the light stays on, or the display shows SERVICE TIRE MONITOR, a sensor is not reporting and the system needs checking.
tpms.note: The CHECK TIRE PRESSURE message also appears when the spare is in use.

tpms.when: 2007–2013 sensor relearn after a tire rotation or sensor replacement (key fob or DIC)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker.
Park, set the parking brake, and turn the ignition on with the engine off.

Press and hold the lock and unlock buttons on the key fob together until the horn chirps twice. On vehicles without keyless entry, use the DIC information button to reach TIRE LEARN and hold SET/RESET.
The left front turn signal lights. At the driver's front tire, let air out for several seconds until the horn chirps once.
Repeat in this order, waiting for a chirp at each: passenger front, passenger rear, driver rear.
Two chirps after the driver rear tire mean the relearn is done. Turn the ignition off.
Set all four tires back to the door sticker pressure, then drive above about 25 mph for at least two minutes before checking the readings.
tpms.note: Redo the relearn after every rotation or sensor replacement. If SERVICE TIRE MONITOR shows or the light stays on after a completed relearn, the system has a fault a reset will not fix.
